base_note: USER_DEFINED demo base on level crater floor south-west of the central mound. Not a proposed or actual landing or habitat site.

sites.name: Central mound — summit bench
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the light-toned bench from the modeled stop and document visible layering. Steep flanks around this demo target may prevent access.

sites.name: Central mound — south-west foot
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the contact where the central mound flank meets the crater floor. Compare visible layering and texture on either side.

sites.name: North-west mound — southern apron
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the apron and lower flank. Compare visible surface texture with the central mound’s apron.

sites.name: Bright-floored crater — west rim
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the rim and bright crater floor from the observation point. Record their visible texture and brightness for comparison with the eastern crater.

sites.name: Southern mound — north foot
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the transition from the northern foot of the isolated mound to the surrounding floor. Compare it with the central mound.

sites.name: Eastern plain crater — rim
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Photograph the dark-floored crater from the rim observation point and compare it with the bright-floored crater. Brightness alone is not a mineral identification.

sites.name: North-east plain
sites.science_rationale: USER_DEFINED demo observation: Take a reference photo of the textured plain away from the mounds to compare with mound-foot observations.
